shape.description: A 1-D integer Tensor or Python array. The shape of the output samples to be drawn per "rate"-parameterized distribution.

lam.description: A Tensor or Python value or N-D array of type `dtype`. `lam` provides the rate parameter(s) describing the poisson distribution(s) to sample.

dtype.description: The type of the output: `float16`, `float32`, `float64`, `int32` or `int64`.

seed.description: A Python integer. Used to create a random seed for the distributions. See `tf.random.set_seed` for behavior.

output.description: a `Tensor` of shape `tf.concat([shape, tf.shape(lam)], axis=0)` with values of type `dtype`.
